summary: Jupiter Neurosciences, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing a 1-for-75 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective 4:01 p.m. ET on August 6, 2026. Every 75 pre-split shares convert into one post-split share with no change in par value; fractional shares are paid in cash based on the prior day's closing price. Exercise prices and share counts under options, warrants, and incentive plans are proportionally adjusted. The authorized share count remains unchanged. Shares continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol JUNS, with a new CUSIP 48208B302. The 8-K includes the Certificate of Amendment as Exhibit 3.1 and references a press release issued August 5, 2026. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
